name: Rejection Reason 12 Code
definition: Specifies the reason of a rejection of a deactivation instruction.

DEAC.name: Event Already Deactivated
DEAC.definition: Rejected as the deactivation of the event is already completed.

FAIL.name: Failed Validation
FAIL.definition: The validation of the advice/instruction/request failed.

SAME.name: Same CA Identification
SAME.definition: An Agent Corporate Action Deactivation Instruction with the same identification already exists.

MAIN.name: Not Main Agent
MAIN.definition: Agent Identification specified does not correspond to the main Agent of the relating event.

OPTI.name: Invalid Option
OPTI.definition: Invalid combination of CA option code and CA option number.

PEDA.name: Pending Deactivation
PEDA.definition: The specified Corporate Action option already has a pending deactivation instruction.

NORO.name: No Remaining Option
NORO.definition: Specified Corporate Action has no remaining options to disable.

INET.name: Invalid Event Type
INET.definition: CA Event Type does not correspond with the relating Corporate Action.

INUS.name: Invalid Underlying Security
INUS.definition: Underlying Security Identification does not correspond with the Corporate Action Reference supplied.

INPT.name: Invalid Event Processing Type
INPT.definition: Event Processing Type does not correspond with the relating Corporate Action.

INMV.name: Invalid Mandatory Voluntary Event Type
INMV.definition: Mandatory/Voluntary Event Type does not correspond with the relating Corporate Action.

SAID.name: Same Identification
SAID.definition: Several message with the same identification.

MICA.name: Mismatched CA Identification
MICA.definition: Issuer CA Identification does not correspond with the Corporate Action Identification supplied.

NOAP.name: Not Applicable
NOAP.definition: This instruction type is not applicable for mandatory events.
